newsitem.title: UK: IPE May gas oil closed $1 higher on fund buying.
newsitem.headline: IPE May gas oil closed $1 higher on fund buying.

text.p: IPE May gas oil futures closed $1.00 higher at $167.50 a tonne on Wednesday, gaining strength from fund buying, brokers said.
May hit a high of $168.50 earlier but also slipped to $166.25, or 25 cenbts a tonne below Tuesday's close.
June Brent was holding onto its highs on the back of bullish U.S. weekly inventory data, trading 13 cents a barrel up at $18.20 by 1659 GMT.
"It (May gas oil) closed up a bit on technical buying in the mid-afternoon," one broker said.
"June Brent has been in this $18.20 area for most of the day and gas oil was following but you also had some fairly good technical buying...It was fund buying coming in there," the broker added.

Traders said that June Brent continued firm on the back of bullish figures from the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) that showed that gasoline stocks dipped 2.4 million barrels in the May 2 week.
The American Petroleum Institute (API) said on Tuesday that demand for gasoline was 8.76 million barrels per day, a figure dismissed by some IPE traders as inaccurate.

Some traders said that gas oil also drew some strength from forecasts of cooler weather over the next two days in north western Europe, but others dismissed that the weahter forecast would have any significant effect. -- Haitham Haddadin, London newsroom +44 171 542 8145
